# x09 summary: orchestration-vocabulary, orchestration-competency, development-lifecycle

## 1. Verdicts and tiers (162 IDs, rollups graded by their weakest child)
| Spec | READY | THIN | DUP | OWNER | BLANK | DECISION | tier bind/sonnet/opus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| orchestration-vocabulary (92) | 16 | 43 | 10 | 7 | 8 | 1 | 22 / 40 / 23 |
| orchestration-competency (48) | 6 | 19 | 9 | 14 | 0 | 0 | 14 / 23 / 11 |
| development-lifecycle (29 open ids) | 8 | 21 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 / 14 / 9 |
Only about 14 percent are READY. Three recurring causes: wrong test path (the suite is `crates/eg-rdf/tests/orchestration_{vocabulary,competency}.rs`; `crates/eg-core/tests/orchestration_*.rs` and `spec_folder.rs`, `architecture_view.rs` do not exist), crate-only proof, and generated boilerplate rows (R616, R750, R751, R800, CQ R700/R701/R800).

## 2. Cross-spec contracts
Decision-engine self-evolution (R805 revision lifecycle, R810 program job, R811 policy receipts, R812.2 challenger rule, R813 score corpus, R179 knobs) meets these specs at five seams.
| Seam | Provider -> consumer | Declared both sides? |
|---|---|---|
| Measured evidence for promotion | ORCH-VOCAB-R010.100 `EvolutionTraceMetrics` -> DE R805.9 / R810.7 / R811.8 | No. DE rows read `held_out` from their own receipts and never name the method. Meristem progress schema also missing. |
| Scores become examples | DE R813.3 reads `:Score`/`:scoresRun` (dataplatform-v1.ttl) <- ORCH-VOCAB R009 RunTrace (`trace_ref`) | Half. R009 has no row declaring `:Score` links or `:evaluationScore` = `:Score`. |
| Harness config choice | ORCH-VOCAB-R011.11 (measured facts) -> DE R128; R010.6 `harness_best_config` | R128 mentions contextWindowTokens facts but cites no R011 row or `:MeasuredModelFact`; R011.11 cites "an EG-DECISION-ENGINE row". |
| Adoption and lessons | ORCH-VOCAB-R801/R802 (supersedes, AdoptedHarness) vs DE R805.7 (champion pointer) and R803 (HarnessContrastDecision) | No. Two lifecycles: R801 "published version immutable + supersedes" and R802 "adopted harness supersedes" versus R805 Draft/Evaluated/Published/Champion/Retired with a pointer store. |
| Defect triage | EG-SDLC-R004.3 -> DE | No `DEFECT_TRIAGE` kind in DE (grep: none on main or the branch), though `crates/eg-types/src/decision/defect_triage.rs` exists. |
R179 knobs: no row in these specs uses `knob <family>.<name>` format. Prose thresholds that should be knobs: R010.6 (20 traces), R009.18 (p95 2000 ms, error 0.02), R003.8 SimilarityPolicyV1 min score, R616.6 budget, R012.2 rules, SDLC R004.2 blame recency.
Missing-side table (consumer row | provider spec | proposed provider text):
| consumer | provider | missing provider row |
|---|---|---|
| DE R805.9, R810.7 | orchestration-vocabulary | in R010.100: "`EvolutionTraceMetrics` supplies `ProgramRevision.held_out` and `PolicyEvaluation` metrics; unknown trace = partial" |
| DE R813.3 | orchestration-vocabulary | R009.x: "RunTrace links `:Score` by `:scoresRun`; `:evaluationScore` is derived from `:Score.value`" |

## 3. Overlaps and duplicate authority
- Workflow/agent/prompt types defined three times: ORCH-VOCAB-R616.1 (AgentSpec, PromptSpec, WorkflowSpec), R800.1 (AgentDefinition, PromptTemplate, WorkflowPattern), CQ-ORCH-R700.1 (WorkflowSpec). Owner: R800.1 only.
- Composed seven-part answer: ORCH-VOCAB-R007.3 and CQ-ORCH-R008.5 are the same test. Owner: CQ-ORCH-R008.
- Policy ingest: ORCH-VOCAB-R004.700/.701 and R004.4 versus R012.2/.7. Owner: R012.
- Planning admission by architecture gap: CQ-ORCH-R010.7 `PlanAdmissionV1` versus DE R171. Owner: DE R171; R010.1-.6 provides the view.
- Best configuration: ORCH-VOCAB-R010.6 `harness_best_config` versus DE R128. Owner: DE (a choice); R010.6 keeps the evidence query.
- Team promotion/reuse: ORCH-VOCAB-R003.8 and R751.751 versus DE R135 and R805. Owner: DE.
- Joint model and width adjustment: ORCH-VOCAB-R009.18 versus DE R136. Owner: DE R136 (+ AU-CONTROL-R006.30).
- Incident/run views: CQ-ORCH-R800 versus ORCH-VOCAB-R009/R010 and unified-data-plane R760. R750 market bids versus existing `eg_types::work_market`. CQ-ORCH-R701 formats belong to connectors.

## 4. Hot paths
Real entry points: `IndexRepository` (`src/server/dispatch/router/source_ingest.rs`), `AddNode` arm (`gateway_graph.rs`, routed via `harness_admission::direct_add_node`), `ApplyChangeEnvelopes` (`dispatch/change_envelope.rs`), `handle_impact` (`mining/impact.rs:264`), `Decide` assemble (`decide/assemble.rs`). Never reach one: R010.1-.5 queries (no UQL name; no `harness_*` symbol in src), R013.3 digest validation (no reader), R750/R751/R800/R616 (no entry), CQ R700/R701 (served method unnamed), all SDLC served methods (no `RecordRelease`, `SpecStatus`, `LifecycleTrace` in src; `crates/eg-core/src/lifecycle/*` has no caller in `src/`).

## 5. VERIFIED isolation spot check (10 largest roots)
| Root | Evidence |
|---|---|
| ORCH-VOCAB-R801 | `HarnessComponentVersion` used in `src/server/harness_admission/tests.rs` and the admission path in `gateway.rs:142`; `current_harness_component` has zero `src/` callers (only `eg-types` tests). Partial. |
| ORCH-VOCAB-R802 | `AdoptedHarness`, `HarnessLesson`, `retrieve_lessons` live in `crates/eg-types/src/orchestration/improvement.rs`; zero `src/` references. Isolated. |
| ORCH-VOCAB-R001, R002 | Ontology reaches runtime: `crates/eg-core/src/graph/schema_sources.rs:885` `include_str!` of orchestration-v1.ttl. Data-only, proven by eg-rdf tests. Acceptable. |
| CQ-ORCH-R001..R007 | Tests in `crates/eg-rdf/tests/orchestration_competency.rs` run SPARQL over fixtures under `eg-core/tests/fixtures/orchestration_competency/q{n}`; no served UQL/NL path. By the brief these CQs are not proven. |
SDLC (13 VERIFIED leaves, no root) are crate-only: `derive_lifecycle_edges` at `crates/eg-core/src/lifecycle/derive.rs:241`, `derive_spec_status` (`status.rs`), trace.rs have no `src/` caller.

## 6. Five most common gaps
1. Wrong or missing test path (eg-core vs eg-rdf): ORCH-VOCAB R003.6, R007.1, R010.1-.5, R011.9. 2. Crate-only proof for CQs: CQ-ORCH R008.5, R011.1-.5. 3. Generated boilerplate: R616.*, R750.*, R751.*, R800.*, CQ R700/R701. 4. Methods that do not exist and no contract row: SDLC R002.3/R005.3/R006.3, R009.101, R010.100. 5. Wall-clock p99 in PR tests (SDLC R002.6, R005.6; breaks zero-flake) and prose thresholds not knobs.

## 7. Decisions and recommendations
1. One revision lifecycle: make R801 versions, R802 adoptions and R003.8 teams `RevisionSubject` kinds under DE R805.7 (recommended), not parallel supersedes chains.
2. Retire R616 and CQ R700.1/R800; keep R800.1 as the single type set.
3. R010.100 stays a read view over UnifiedQuery unless Meristem supplies the progress schema; do not add a Method first.
4. Add DE `defect_triage` family and SDLC wire rows to the contract spec before SDLC wiring lanes start.
5. Convert every threshold above to `knob` rows; move p99 tests to nightly bench groups.
